intro: Government and technology sectors faced significant exposure across North America, the EU, and globally, with six articles from April to June 2026 covering vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-42271, CVE-2024-57728, CVE-2026-9082, CVE-2009-0238, and CVE-2025-2749. The severity mix included one critical, three high, and two medium ratings, with top CVEs such as CVE-2026-42271 scoring 8.7 and CVE-2024-57728 at 7.2. Enterprise software and federal government systems were among the affected sectors, while no specific threat actors were named in the provided data.
